semiconductor_relevance: High — NANOSTONE PTE. LTD. provides critical frequency control products and sensors essential for semiconductor applications.
summary: NANOSTONE PTE. LTD. specializes in the development and manufacturing of frequency control products such as quartz crystal units, resonators, and oscillators, which are vital for precise timing in electronic devices. They also produce piezo sensors and are involved in R&D of power semiconductor devices, focusing on MOSFETs for import substitution.
